datasets.license: No license or terms of use are stated. The archive is posted for public download on David Card's Berkeley faculty page (davidcard.berkeley.edu/data_sets.html, 'Available data sets', listed as the data set associated with Card and Krueger 1994, AER), whose footer reads '(c)2014 The Regents of the University of California'. The bundled read.me states only that the files 'pertain to the New Jersey - Pennsylvania surveys used in Myth and Measurement, chapter 2' and gives no conditions of use. Used here for non-commercial research replication, the purpose for which the authors distribute it; raw and derived files are git-ignored and rebuilt by the logged runs, not redistributed.
datasets.integrity_check: No checksum is published. code/fetch_data.py pins the size and SHA-256 observed on the first retrieval (server Last-Modified 27 Jul 2007, ETag "46aa0c0d-59e9") and fails on any difference.

datasets.origin: Member public.dat of njmin.zip (dataset njmin-zip), extracted by code/fetch_data.py.
